# Bid the flue and the height, not the house.

> Price a chimney sweep from flue type, stories, roof access, and creosote — not a flat house rate. See labor hours, walk-away price, and the margin a neighborhood special actually leaves.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
